requirements.normative_requirement: The canonical checkout and host repository metadata are never mounted or exposed through a writable host VFS provider.
requirements.threat_or_failure: Host confused deputy and canonical mutation
requirements.primary_verification: Mount/provider inventory plus malicious symlink/rename campaign; canonical pre/post digest unchanged.

requirements.normative_requirement: The writable workspace resides entirely on guest-owned block storage.
requirements.threat_or_failure: Host pathname authority under adversarial mutation
requirements.primary_verification: Backend attestation proves no writable host filesystem device/provider is attached.

requirements.normative_requirement: Host-to-guest import is read-only and bounded; guest-to-host export is typed and bounded.
requirements.primary_verification: Protocol fuzzing and attempts to request arbitrary host paths through both channels.
